purpose: Form DIR-6 is used by an individual to intimate any changes in their particulars as stated in Form DIR-3 to the Central Government.
who: Every individual who has been allotted a Director Identification Number
when: Within a period of thirty days of such change(s)
steps: Download Form DIR-6 from the portal.
Verify the form and attach a duly scanned copy of the proof of the changed particulars.
Ensure the form is digitally signed by a chartered accountant in practice, a company secretary in practice, or a cost accountant in practice.
checklist: Details of the changes in particulars
Scanned copy of the proof of the changed particulars
Digital signature of a chartered accountant in practice, company secretary in practice, or cost accountant in practice
attachments: Duly scanned copy of the proof of the changed particulars
watch: The form must be submitted within thirty days of such change.
